verdict: Leads holding steady; cost per lead is down, but tracking gaps need closing.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 123 leads at a cost of $10.77 per lead — a 34.8% improvement in cost per lead compared to the prior week. Spend did contract during that same week, so part of the efficiency gain reflects lower volume rather than pure conversion improvement; lead output has held up so far despite the tighter daily spend. Two tracking items — phone-call attribution and contact data cleanup — are still open, which means 71 Google Business Profile calls this period are not yet tied to your lead scoreboard, and the opportunity data in your CRM cannot yet be fully trusted. Both are being resolved ahead of the August 31 dashboard review, at which point the full picture of leads-to-patients will be readable and the renewal decision can rest on reliable numbers.
